name: Factor analysis at relaxed cohort (DSI > 0.2 AND PD > 3) to test all-negative PD claim
short_description: Re-run t0108 varimax factor analysis on t0106 cells with relaxed thresholds DSI > 0.2 AND PD > 3 (247 cells); compare DSI/PD factor correlations vs t0108 strict cohort to test the truncated-cohort hypothesis.
